{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify rows with sentinel value -999.0 in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_rows = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]

# Check if these rows are distributed evenly across arms
sentinel_by_arm = sentinel_rows['arm'].value_counts()

# Check if these rows are distributed evenly across severity
sentinel_by_severity = sentinel_rows['severity'].value_counts()

# Check if these rows are distributed evenly across sex
sentinel_by_sex = sentinel_rows['sex'].value_counts()

print(f'Rows with sentinel value -999.0 in biomarker_baseline by arm:\n{sentinel_by_arm}')
print(f'\nRows with sentinel value -999.0 in biomarker_baseline by severity:\n{sentinel_by_severity}')
print(f'\nRows with sentinel value -999.0 in biomarker_baseline by sex:\n{sentinel_by_sex}')"}
